claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace never brings him within 780 metres of the pickup pin on this trip: the minimum separation recorded across all 98 driver fixes is 779.93 m. POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable ONLY IF limb (b) holds, that is, only if the trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event. It plainly does not, so limb (b) fails and the $4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable at all.

The arrival radius for this STANDARD zone pickup is 50 m under POL-NS-02, and the trace contains zero qualifying in-radius fixes for the driver (qualifying_fix_count 0 across 98 driver fixes) at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the 08:09:40 cancellation. Under POL-NS-02 the driver is therefore deemed never to have arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

POL-NS-03 cannot be used to rescue this fee. That clause governs a driver who was stationary outside the arrival radius but within the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling. Here the driver was never closer than 779.93 m from the pin at any moment of the trip, so he was outside the ceiling throughout, this is not a wrong-entrance or wrong-block case, and no POL-NS-03(ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill payment arises.

The 'arrived' marker on this trip is a false arrival marker under POL-NS-05. It is timed at 2026-07-23T08:02:14+08:00, a moment at which the trace places the driver at least 780 m from the pickup pin (the minimum separation for the whole trace is 779.93 m), far beyond the 300 m threshold that clause sets. The marker is FALSE and does not start the waiting clock.

On the POL-NS-05 recomputed basis the fee must be refunded in full. The waiting clock restarts from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, so under POL-NS-05(ii) the $4.00 fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is to be recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list.

Independently, the waiting-period shortfall route under POL-NS-06 gives the same result. The effective in-geofence dwell for this STANDARD zone pickup is 0 seconds against a 300 second minimum - a shortfall of 300 seconds - so the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

The accumulation limb POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable to the driver here. EV-ADVIS-00201-01 is MISSING - admissibility status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0 - so there is no present and populated traffic_advisory that could permit separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, and on the derived facts there are zero in-geofence intervals to sum in any event. I cite the absent artifact for its absence alone.

POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider outright on all three limbs. (a) The rider sent a locating and coordinating message at 08:05:33 - 'hello? i dont see any car at 118' - which both names the block and states that he cannot see the vehicle. (b) The driver posted no reply at all and placed no in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty), so no reply came inside 120 seconds or at any time before termination. (c) The rider track places the rider's device within the STANDARD 100 m presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes - in fact for all 122 of them, with a maximum deviation of 24.9 m. The rider is exonerated and the fee refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable.

No driver compensation is payable under POL-NS-07. That clause operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 fails on the driver's own trace and POL-NS-04, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 each independently displace the fee, so the 80 percent payout of SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 fee does not arise.

The outcome here is party-relative and the record fixes it. This dispute was filed by the rider, and the fare_breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0 and a 4.00 cancellation-fee line. NO_ACTION would therefore leave the rider carrying the disputed charge, which the evidence does not support; the correct ruling is FULL_REFUND of the cancellation-fee line only, not of any booking or platform fee that would have been charged on a completed trip.

This case does not need to be escalated, and the rider should not be left with the fee merely held. The POL-NS-09 triggers are absent: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and nothing in the bundle is impaired under the POL-NS-08 limbs - the trace has 100 percent coverage, no gaps and a 10 second cadence, and the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count. The apparent tension between the trip record's 'arrived' marker and the trace is exactly what POL-NS-05 exists to resolve, so it is not an unresolved conflict requiring human review.

ruling.explanation:
The $4.00 cancellation fee cannot stand, and it is refunded in full.

To the driver (DRV-01590): the finding comes first from your own telemetry. Across all 98 fixes of the trip your vehicle never came closer than 779.9 m to the pickup pin at Blk 118 Rivervale Drive, and there were zero admissible fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at any point in the 15 minutes before the cancellation. That means POL-NS-01 is not satisfied: limb (b) fails (the trace does not place you in the pickup geofence) and limb (c) fails (in-geofence dwell was 0 seconds against the 300 second minimum). Your 'arrived' marker at 08:02:14 was therefore placed while you were more than 300 m from the pin, so under POL-NS-05 it is a FALSE arrival marker and does not start the waiting clock. Recomputing the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix yields no such fix anywhere in the trip, so POL-NS-05(ii) refunds the fee in full, awards no compensation, and directs the false-arrival record that appears in the referrals above. The same result follows independently under POL-NS-02 (no qualifying in-radius fix, so you are deemed never to have arrived) and under POL-NS-06 (0 seconds of effective dwell against the 300 second minimum). The accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00201-01 is MISSING (status MISSING, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), so separate intervals could not be summed even if there were any, and the absence is cited for the absence alone. Because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 compensation does not arise — the 80% payout presupposes a fully met anchor clause. Your profile does not trip the anti-farming guard (3 no-show terminations in 30 days, 3.1% of 96 completed trips — both below the absolute and rate limbs of POL-NS-07), so nothing is withheld on that ground and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged; that point is accepted but changes nothing here.

To the rider: your account is corroborated throughout. Your device stayed within 25 m of the pin on all 122 qualifying fixes, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is satisfied for the majority (in fact all) of your fixes. Your message at 08:05:33 — 'hello? i dont see any car at 118' — is a locating and coordinating message that both named the block and stated you could not see the vehicle, and the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty). POL-NS-04 therefore independently exonerates you and refunds the fee in full, with no driver compensation payable. POL-NS-03 does not rescue the fee either: that clause requires the driver to be stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, and he was never closer than 779.9 m, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises.

Amount: the refund is the $4.00 cancellation-fee line only, which reconciles with the STANDARD zone-class and RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee. No booking or platform fee was charged, so none is refunded. This is a rider-filed dispute and the charge is presently CHARGED with no refund issued, so FULL_REFUND restores the position rather than leaving you with the fee.

No escalation is warranted: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the rider and driver have no prior disputes between them, the rider's 30-day no-show dispute count is 0, and the apparent tension between the trip record's arrival marker and the trace is precisely the conflict POL-NS-05 exists to resolve, not an unresolved one. The bundle is unimpaired — the trace has 100% coverage, no gaps and a 10 second cadence, the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count, and the fare line reconciles — so the confidence cap is set by artifacts of weight 1.0.
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record a false-arrival event against driver DRV-01590 on trip TRP-00201 — the 'arrived' marker at 2026-07-23T08:02:14+08:00 was placed while the GPS trace put the driver at least 779.9 m from the pickup pin, and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full. To the driver: the fee is not chargeable on this record, and no compensation is payable.

Why the fee cannot stand. The anchor clause, POL-NS-01, makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four of its conditions hold. Limb (a) is met — the trip record does carry an 'arrived' event at 08:02:14 — and limb (d) is met, because the driver terminated the trip at 08:09:40 under RIDER_NO_SHOW rather than DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. Limbs (b) and (c) both fail on the driver's own telemetry. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00201, weight 1.0) contains 98 driver fixes and never brings the vehicle closer than 779.93 m to the pin; there are zero qualifying in-geofence fixes at the STANDARD 50 m radius, and the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 seconds against the 300 second minimum dwell. POL-NS-01 therefore fails, and the fee is not chargeable. Both advocates' claims on this point are accepted — the Driver Advocate correctly concedes he cannot carry limbs (b) and (c), and the Rider Advocate's figures are the same ones the trace itself reports.

POL-NS-02 adds the same conclusion independently: with no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes before cancellation, the driver is deemed never to have arrived, limb (b) fails, and the fee is refunded in full.

POL-NS-05 resolves the one apparent conflict in this bundle. The trip record says 'arrived' at 08:02:14 while the trace puts the driver nearly 800 m away — that contradiction is not an open question, it is precisely the situation POL-NS-05 exists to address. The arrival marker is FALSE, it does not start the waiting clock, and on the recomputed basis there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip. Under POL-NS-05(ii) the $4.00 fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is to be recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver. That record is the referral attached to this ruling.

POL-NS-06 reaches the same result a third time: effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against a 300 second minimum, a shortfall of 300 seconds, so the cancellation-fee line is refunded whether or not the rider was present or responsive.

POL-NS-03 cannot rescue the fee. That clause governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin. The driver was never closer than 779.93 m, so he was outside the ceiling throughout, this is not a wrong-entrance case, and no POL-NS-03(ii) goodwill payment arises.

POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider on all three limbs. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00201, weight 1.0) shows the rider's message at 08:05:33 — 'hello? i dont see any car at 118' — which names the block and states he cannot see the vehicle; the driver posted no reply and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so nothing came within 120 seconds or at any point before termination; and the rider track places the device within the STANDARD 100 m presence radius for all 122 qualifying fixes, with a maximum deviation of 24.9 m. This clause independently refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; neither condition holds, so the 80 percent payout (SGD 3.20) does not arise. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not trip in any event: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3 (below the absolute limb of 4) and 3 of 96 completed trips is 3.1 percent (below the 0.08 rate limb), and POL-NS-07 requires both limbs.

No escalation is warranted. POL-NS-09 is not engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the profile counters for repeat disputes and rider abuse are all 0, the anti-farming check does not trip, and no artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d) — the trace has 100 percent coverage, no gaps and a 10 second cadence; the chat log's two messages match the trip record's chat_message_count; and the $4.00 fee reconciles with the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00). The tension between the arrival marker and the trace is resolved by POL-NS-05, so it is not the unresolved conflict POL-NS-09(b) describes.

The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00201-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0. It is cited by the rider only for its absence — as the reason POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable — and a MISSING artifact carries no fact. Its absence changes nothing here, since the trace shows zero in-geofence intervals to accumulate in any case.

The refund is limited to the cancellation-fee line of $4.00 (EV-FARE-00201, weight 1.0); no booking or platform fee that would have applied to a completed trip is refunded. Confidence 0.92, capped by the weight-1.0 artifacts that carry the deciding facts.

ruling.explanation: This dispute is about the S$4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged to the rider, and both briefs are answered together where they make the same point. The charge can stand only if all four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold. The trip record supplies (a) a driver 'arrived' event at 08:02:14 and (d) a driver termination at 08:09:40 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, and the Driver Advocate is right about that — but limbs (b) and (c) fail, as the Driver Advocate itself concedes. Across the driver's own 98 GPS fixes the closest he came to the pin was 779.93 m; there were zero qualifying in-geofence fixes at the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius; and the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 s against the 300 s minimum dwell. The conjunctive anchor clause therefore fails and the fee is not chargeable. The rider's POL-NS-02 point is accepted: with no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before cancellation, the driver is deemed never to have arrived and the fee is refunded in full. POL-NS-03 cannot rescue it — the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling requires the driver to have been stationary outside the radius but within 400 m, and he was never closer than 779.93 m — so no POL-NS-03(ii) goodwill payment arises. The 'arrived' marker is also a false arrival marker under POL-NS-05: at 08:02:14 the trace puts the driver more than 300 m from the pin. On the POL-NS-05 recomputed basis there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, so the fee is refunded in full, no compensation is payable, and the trip must be recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver — that clause-directed instruction is carried in the referrals list. POL-NS-06 independently gives the same full refund: effective in-geofence dwell of 0 s against the 300 s minimum, and the accumulation limb (i) is unavailable because EV-ADVIS-00201-01, the traffic advisory, is MISSING with weight 0.0 — nothing present and populated permits separate intervals to be summed, and there are in any event zero intervals to sum. POL-NS-04 additionally exonerates the rider on all three limbs: (a) the rider's 08:05:33 message named the block and stated he could not see the car; (b) the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed any in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty); and (c) the rider track keeps the device within the STANDARD 100 m presence radius for all 122 qualifying fixes, maximum deviation 24.9 m. POL-NS-07 compensation does not arise because it operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and POL-NS-04, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 each displace the fee; POL-GEN-03 confirms that on this rider-filed dispute the outcome is a refund of the cancellation-fee line only, not of any booking or platform fee that a completed trip would have attracted. The driver's anti-farming argument is accepted: no_show_terminations_30d is 3 — below the absolute limb of 4 — and 3/96 is 3.1%, below the 0.08 rate limb, so POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged and the profile is not adverse to him. On escalation: no POL-NS-09 trigger fires. The apparent tension between the trip record's arrival marker and the trace is exactly what POL-NS-05 resolves, so limb (b) does not apply; no profile shows 2 or more disputes between these parties (limb (c)); the anti-farming check does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 (limb (d)); and the trace is complete at 100% coverage, no gap over 120 s and a 10 s cadence, while the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count, so nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d) (limb (e)). On weight: the deciding facts (the driver's absence and the false marker) are carried by the GPS trace, the trip record and the chat log, all at weight 1.0; the only artifact below 1.0 is the MISSING advisory at 0.0, which carries no fact and is cited solely for its absence — so no discount applies, confidence is not capped below 1.0, and the ruling is comfortably above the 0.70 floor. Result: the S$4.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider, and no driver compensation is payable.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: the $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full. Your account and the telemetry agree. The driver's own GPS record (98 fixes, 10-second cadence, full coverage of the window) never brings him closer than 779.93 m to Blk 118 Rivervale Drive, and it contains zero in-geofence fixes at the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. POL-NS-01 only lets the fee stand if all four conditions hold, and limb (b) — the trace placing the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event — plainly fails, on the driver's own evidence. POL-NS-02 then gives the refund directly: with no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before the 08:09:40 cancellation, the driver is deemed never to have arrived. Three further routes reach the same result: POL-NS-05 makes the 08:02:14 'arrived' marker FALSE (the driver was over 300 m away, in fact over 780 m), and its limb (ii) refunds the fee in full because there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip; POL-NS-06 refunds the fee for a 300-second shortfall against the 300-second STANDARD minimum dwell (measured dwell: 0 seconds); and POL-NS-04 exonerates you outright, since you sent a locating message at 08:05:33 ('hello? i dont see any car at 118'), the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor made any in-app call, and your device sat within the 100 m presence radius for all 122 of your fixes. You are refunded the cancellation-fee line only; no booking or platform fee arises on a cancelled trip.

To the driver: the fee cannot stand, and I record that your advocate conceded this — your 98-fix track never reaches the pin, records zero qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest in-geofence run of 0.0 seconds against a 300-second minimum. That concession against your own interest is accepted, and it is corroborated independently by the trace. POL-NS-03 does not rescue the fee: its 400 m ceiling is the whole test, and you were never within 780 m of the pin, so this is not a wrong-entrance case and no pin-ambiguity goodwill payment arises. POL-NS-07 compensation does not arise either, because it operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; here limb (b) fails and POL-NS-04, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 each displace the fee. Your profile supports that: the anti-farming guard requires BOTH a count of 4 or more and a rate above 0.08, and you show 3 terminations across 96 completed trips (3.1%), so no farming finding is made against you.

On escalation: this is not an unresolved conflict under POL-NS-09(b). The tension between the trip record's 'arrived' marker and the GPS track is exactly what POL-NS-05 exists to resolve, and POL-NS-05 resolves it against the marker; POL-NS-02 likewise defines arrival by the trace. No profile trigger is met (both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, rider no-show disputes are 0, the anti-farming check does not trip), and nothing in the bundle is impaired under the POL-NS-08 limbs — no clock skew, no sampling gap above 120 seconds, 98 fixes, the chat log's 2 messages match the trip record, and the $4.00 fee reconciles with the greater of the STANDARD zone fee and the RYDE_X tier fee. The one impaired artifact, the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00201-01 (weight 0.0), is cited only for its absence, to confirm that POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable; it carries no deciding fact and does not depress confidence. Confidence is capped at 1.0 by the deciding artifact, GPS trace EV-GPS-00201 (weight 1.0), and stands at 0.95.

ledger.claim: The driver's own GPS trace never brings him within 780 metres of the pickup pin on this trip: the minimum separation recorded across all 98 driver fixes is 779.93 m. POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable ONLY IF limb (b) holds, that is, only if the trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event. It plainly does not, so limb (b) fails and the $4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable at all.

The arrival radius for this STANDARD zone pickup is 50 m under POL-NS-02, and the trace contains zero qualifying in-radius fixes for the driver (qualifying_fix_count 0 across 98 driver fixes) at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the 08:09:40 cancellation. Under POL-NS-02 the driver is therefore deemed never to have arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

POL-NS-03 cannot be used to rescue this fee. That clause governs a driver who was stationary outside the arrival radius but within the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling. Here the driver was never closer than 779.93 m from the pin at any moment of the trip, so he was outside the ceiling throughout, this is not a wrong-entrance or wrong-block case, and no POL-NS-03(ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill payment arises.

The 'arrived' marker on this trip is a false arrival marker under POL-NS-05. It is timed at 2026-07-23T08:02:14+08:00, a moment at which the trace places the driver at least 780 m from the pickup pin (the minimum separation for the whole trace is 779.93 m), far beyond the 300 m threshold that clause sets. The marker is FALSE and does not start the waiting clock.

On the POL-NS-05 recomputed basis the fee must be refunded in full. The waiting clock restarts from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, so under POL-NS-05(ii) the $4.00 fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is to be recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list.

Independently, the waiting-period shortfall route under POL-NS-06 gives the same result. The effective in-geofence dwell for this STANDARD zone pickup is 0 seconds against a 300 second minimum - a shortfall of 300 seconds - so the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

The accumulation limb POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable to the driver here. EV-ADVIS-00201-01 is MISSING - admissibility status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0 - so there is no present and populated traffic_advisory that could permit separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, and on the derived facts there are zero in-geofence intervals to sum in any event. I cite the absent artifact for its absence alone.

POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider outright on all three limbs. (a) The rider sent a locating and coordinating message at 08:05:33 - 'hello? i dont see any car at 118' - which both names the block and states that he cannot see the vehicle. (b) The driver posted no reply at all and placed no in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty), so no reply came inside 120 seconds or at any time before termination. (c) The rider track places the rider's device within the STANDARD 100 m presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes - in fact for all 122 of them, with a maximum deviation of 24.9 m. The rider is exonerated and the fee refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable.

No driver compensation is payable under POL-NS-07. That clause operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 fails on the driver's own trace and POL-NS-04, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 each independently displace the fee, so the 80 percent payout of SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 fee does not arise.

The outcome here is party-relative and the record fixes it. This dispute was filed by the rider, and the fare_breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0 and a 4.00 cancellation-fee line. NO_ACTION would therefore leave the rider carrying the disputed charge, which the evidence does not support; the correct ruling is FULL_REFUND of the cancellation-fee line only, not of any booking or platform fee that would have been charged on a completed trip.

This case does not need to be escalated, and the rider should not be left with the fee merely held. The POL-NS-09 triggers are absent: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and nothing in the bundle is impaired under the POL-NS-08 limbs - the trace has 100 percent coverage, no gaps and a 10 second cadence, and the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count. The apparent tension between the trip record's 'arrived' marker and the trace is exactly what POL-NS-05 exists to resolve, so it is not an unresolved conflict requiring human review.

The trip record carries the two things POL-NS-01 asks of the driver personally: a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 08:02:14, and a termination by the driver at 08:09:40 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW rather than DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. Limbs (a) and (d) are therefore met on the face of the record, and the driver used one of the three truthful codes the clause recognises.

I cannot carry limbs (b) and (c) of POL-NS-01 on this trace, and I do not ask the Judge to find otherwise. The driver's own 98-fix GPS track never comes closer than 779.9 m to the pickup pin, records zero qualifying in-geofence fixes at the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m, and shows a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0.0 seconds against the 300 second minimum dwell. The arrival and dwell limbs of the anchor clause fail on the driver's own telemetry, so the cancellation fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 and I do not contend that it stands.

The driver's profile does not support a fee-farming finding, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the absolute limb of 4, and 3 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 96 is 3.1 percent, below the 0.08 rate limb. The clause requires BOTH limbs and neither is met, so POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged against this driver and this record should not be read as a pattern of harvested no-show fees.
